general.description: Lightweight coding agent that runs in your terminal

general.name: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search
general.description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.

general.name: multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills
general.description: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls.
general.description_zh: 单个 CLAUDE.md 文件，用于改进 Claude Code 的表现，源自 Andrej Karpathy 对 LLM 编码常见问题的观察。
features: 提供单一 CLAUDE.md 文件用于改进 Claude Code 行为
强制显式推理：明确假设、提出多种解释、必要时反推
倡导极简主义，避免过度工程和冗余抽象
执行外科手术式修改，仅触碰必要代码并清理自身遗留
以目标驱动执行，强调 tests-first 和可验证的成功标准

general.name: makeplane/plane
general.description: 🔥🔥🔥 Open-source Jira, Linear, Monday, and ClickUp alternative. Plane is a modern project management platform to manage tasks, sprints, docs, and triage.
general.description_zh: 🔥🔥🔥 开源的 Jira、Linear、Monday 和 ClickUp 替代品。Plane 是一个现代项目管理平台，用于管理任务、sprint、文档和 triage。

general.name: anthropics/claude-plugins-community
general.description: Community plugin marketplace for Claude Cowork and Claude Code. Read-only mirror — submit plugins at clau.de/plugin-directory-submission.
general.description_zh: 面向 Claude Cowork 和 Claude Code 的社区插件市场。只读镜像——请在 clau.de/plugin-directory-submission 提交插件。

general.name: AprilNEA/OpenLogi
general.description: ⚡️A native, local-first alternative to Logitech Options+, written in Rust 🦀 — remap buttons, DPI, and SmartShift over HID++. No account, no telemetry.
general.description_zh: ⚡️原生、本地优先的 Logitech Options+ 替代方案，使用 Rust 编写 🦀 — 通过 HID++ 重映射按键、DPI 和 SmartShift。无需账户，无遥测。

general.name: apache/maka
general.description: Apache Maka (Incubating) is a local-first AI agent workspace. Model messages, tool calls, tool results, permission decisions, and termination events are recorded as an append-only log.
general.description_zh: Apache Maka（孵化中）是一个本地优先的 AI agent 工作空间。模型消息、工具调用、工具结果、权限决策和终止事件都以只追加日志的形式记录。

general.name: PostHog/posthog
general.description: 🦔 PostHog is the leading platform for building self-driving products. Our developer tools – AI observability, analytics, session replay, flags, experiments, error tracking, logs, and more – capture all the context agents need to diagnose problems, uncover opportunities, and ship fixes. Steer it all from Slack, web, desktop, or the MCP.

general.description: Your own personal AI assistant. Any OS. Any Platform. The lobster way. 🦞

general.name: AgriciDaniel/claude-obsidian
general.description: Self-organizing AI second brain for Obsidian + Claude Code. Drop any source and Claude reads, links, and files it into one connected knowledge graph of plain Markdown you own. AI note-taking, personal knowledge management (PKM), and an open-source Notion alternative. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.
